projects.title: Medilogs
projects.description:
•	Worked in a team of three people to develop a Windows 8 Application titled “MediLogs” using C#, WCF, and WPF.
•	Users were able to keep track of medical conditions by creating entries in their log. For each entry, the user could take a photo, enter a description, and create tags for the entry.

projects.title: 4x4x4 LED Cube
projects.description:
Designed and implemented digital computer circuits using CAD tools for Nexys2 Spartan -­ 3E FPGA Board.
Implemented assembly language programming to control LED Cube patterns using a keyboard.
